THE CUEPROMPT CREATOR GUIDE

Free Online Teleprompter for Presentations

More presence. Less memorizing.

From a webinar introduction to a conference speech, a clear structure makes your message easier to follow. CuePrompt displays your script in a scrolling reading view so you can concentrate on delivery.

Try the free teleprompter →

Turn notes into speaking cues

Start with your opening, the main points, and your closing sentence. Use simple language and visible paragraph breaks. If a full script feels too rigid, use short prompts that remind you what comes next.

Rehearse your transitions

Adjust scrolling until you can pause naturally without rushing. Space pauses the script when you are outside the editor. For video calls, keep this browser window beside your meeting; CuePrompt does not add an overlay to another application.

Private by design

Your draft is saved on this device using browser storage. No account is required. Export a copy of important scripts before clearing your browser data. Camera recordings are created locally and downloaded when you choose. If you turn on Smart Follow, your browser sends microphone audio to its own speech service to transcribe it.
